faq_q1: How do I start a new chat?
faq_a1: You can click on the '+' icon in the sidebar header to open the directory search, or go to the 'Contacts' tab and select a saved contact to begin chatting instantly.
faq_q2: How do I create a group or community?
faq_a2: In the sidebar search bar header, click the '+' button and select 'New Group' or 'New Community'. You can choose a name, upload a picture, and add members from your contact list.
faq_q3: How do I send stickers, GIFs, or create polls?
faq_a3: Inside any active chat, click the attachment '+' button next to the input field. From the dropdown, you can select 'Sticker', 'Poll' or 'Event' to initiate the respective widgets.
faq_q4: How do I manage privacy and blocked contacts?
faq_a4: Navigate to Settings > Privacy > Block contacts to view and manage your blocked contacts directory. You can block or unblock users directly from their profiles or from this screen.
faq_q5: Can I customize the chat appearance?
faq_a5: Yes! Go to Settings > Chats > Default chat wallpaper, where you can select preset accent color backgrounds to customize the chat theme appearance according to your preference.

faq_q6: How do I send files or images in chat?
faq_a6: Click the paperclip icon in the chat input bar. You can send images, documents, videos, and audio files up to 50MB.
faq_q7: How do I enable disappearing messages?
faq_a7: Go to Settings → Privacy → Disappearing messages and select a duration.
faq_q8: Can I use MYCHATBOX on multiple devices?
faq_a8: Currently, one active session is supported per account.
faq_q9: How do I change my profile picture?
faq_a9: Go to Settings → Profile. Tap the camera icon on your avatar to upload a new photo.
faq_q10: What happens when I delete my account?
faq_a10: Deleting your account permanently removes all your messages, contacts, and community memberships.
